key.name: window-state
key.description: A JSON array holding the initial width, height and maximize state of the app window.

key.name: autostart
key.description: Whether the app asks the portal to autostart it when the session begins.

key.name: start-paused
key.description: Whether the app starts paused rather than resuming the saved playing state.

key.name: dark-mode
key.description: Used only when the system does not support colour schemes itself.

key.name: inhibit-suspension
key.summary: Keep the system awake while playing

key.name: scroll-position
key.description: Vertical scroll position of the sounds grid.

key.name: volume
key.description: Volume of the main player, from 0 to 1.

key.name: playing
key.description: Whether the main player was playing when the app last exited.

key.name: background-playback
key.description: Whether closing the window hides it and keeps playback running.

key.name: custom-audios
key.description: A JSON object mapping each custom sound's name to its URI.

key.name: presets
key.description: The ids of every preset, in the order they are shown.

key.name: active-preset
key.description: The id of the preset whose volumes are in effect.

key.name: sounds-volume
key.description: Deprecated. Migrated into the default preset on first run.

key.name: visible-name
key.description: The name shown for this preset.

key.name: sounds-volume
key.description: A JSON object mapping each sound's name to its volume, from 0 to 1.

key.name: sounds-mute
key.description: A JSON object mapping each sound's name to whether it is muted.

key.name: hide-inactive
key.description: Whether the sounds grid shows only the sounds that are playing.
